versions.subject: Merge PR #5146 from @resp404nse - Potential SSH Tunnel Persistence Install Using A Scheduled Task
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\schtasks.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'schtasks.exe'
selection_cli_sshd:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' /create '
        - 'sshd.exe'
        - '-f'
selection_cli_ssh:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' /create '
        - 'ssh.exe'
        - '-i'
condition: selection_img and 1 of selection_cli_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\schtasks.exe" OR OriginalFileName="schtasks.exe" (CommandLine="* /create *" CommandLine="*sshd.exe*" CommandLine="*-f*") OR (CommandLine="* /create *" CommandLine="*ssh.exe*" CommandLine="*-i*")
